executive_summary.text: LUTHERAN HOME OF SOUTHBURY, INC. (075371): Operational / Managerial Control from 2015-03-08 to present; staffing during this period averaged 3.99 total nurse HPRD over 33 quarters.
In cost year 2025, homes linked to this company reported $1,122,732 in management fees on DSS cost reports.
